correctness.rationale: Conditioning on source at hub, designated leaves, or other leaves yields exact marginal P(H)=(1+kp)/(k+1), P(L)=(1+p+(k-1)p²)/(k+1) and pair probabilities (2p+(k-1)p²)/(k+1) and (3p²+(k-2)p³)/(k+1). Subtract products and factor the two stated polynomials. A_k increases from -1 to positive for k>=2; B_k for k>=3 is strictly convex on p>=0, initially decreases, and crosses exactly once before 1. Exact identity B_k-(k-1)pA_k/k=2p²-(2+1/k)p-1<0 on [0,1] orders roots. k=2 factor (p-1)(p²+4p+1), k=1 simple two-point result. p=c k^{-2/3} gives B_k=c³-1+O(k^{-1/3}); r_k formula yields (sqrt5-1)/(2k). Independently checked polynomial identity symbolically and exact seed/edge enumeration k=2..6 at p=1/4,1/2,3/4.
